name: Higashidōri (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Higashidōri village emblem in green: a disc pierced by a stylised letter T, like a leaf.
history: Municipal flag of Higashidōri, a village in Aomori Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 October 1973.

features.role: Higashidōri village emblem — a disc pierced by a stylised letter T, like a leaf
